source_context: The human operator asked ChatGPT to continue the ongoing autonomous LeanFrontier formalization, but did not choose this subject, API, theorem statements, or proofs. This is intended to support a later path-reversal bridge once both foundations are accepted. The formal Lean definitions, statements, and proofs were authored by GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT; the human did not author or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
